scenario: M06-03 exact native Stop count feasibility

assessment.native_counting_feasible_in_principle: An isolated Swift observer could count MicrophoneAccess.stop, SystemMicrophone.halt, engine.stop and tap removal separately around an actual UI Stop. No observer was added and none of these counters ran.
assessment.semantic_limit: Background/interruption halt followed by renderer polling cleanup may call halt again; duplicate no-op cleanup would not by itself prove a defect in an explicit single Stop.
assessment.safe_input_prerequisite: Positive isolation from personal microphone input was required before actual Start. Presence of an Input None menu option did not prove that isolation.

bounded_input_attempts.action: AXPress on exact Input None item
bounded_input_attempts.observed: Fresh menu readback retained Use System Settings; isolation not proven.

bounded_input_attempts.action: Opened Device and Sound menus, AXPick on Input None
bounded_input_attempts.observed: Fresh menu readback retained Use System Settings; isolation not proven.

bounded_input_attempts.action: One click at exact visible Input None accessibility rectangle
bounded_input_attempts.observed: Fresh menu readback retained Use System Settings; isolation not proven.

target_scope.controls_used: DeviceHub simulator Sound Input menu only. No Mac audio settings or microphone permissions changed.
target_scope.scope_limit: Because no input selection change was observed, per-device versus shared simulator input-setting scope was not independently established. This is not an OS input-isolation proof.

final_state.additional_restoration_action_unnecessar: Final marked input already matched the preserved prior selection.

M06-04_assessment.reason: No supported genuine cross-process interruption route was established. Opening another foreground app would also trigger existing background cleanup, so that alone could not isolate AVAudioSession interruption.
M06-04_assessment.historical_guidance_limit: Apple archive dated2017 describes simulator interruption limitations; this is historical guidance, not proof about this iOS27 runtime.

documentation.supports: Current DeviceHub simulator Sound Input/Output controls; does not establish a successful None selection.
Actual audio-session notifications and system-versus-app deactivation distinction; no simulator result claimed.

limitations: No pass or product-failure claim for exact native Stop counting.
No personal audio or transcript captured/logged; no recording was started.
No current cross-session interruption or physical-device acceptance claim.
The runtime safe-input gate stopped the experiment before instrumented build; prior clean installed app identity was verified instead of claiming a new clean build.
